override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Rouge (rouge, SR/Electric/Supporter/Burst I) carries ZERO damage lines — no flatDamage/dot/weaponSwap anywhere in the kit — so her whole contribution is (a) skill2 Sword Coin Attack Damage +6.65% to self+adjacent, (b) burst ATK +15.07% of HER ATK to all allies for 10s, and (c) the skill1 team burst-CDR 7s every 8 full charges, which is the single largest lever in the kit (it accelerates the whole team's rotation). Everything else is Max-HP / damage-taken bookkeeping that is offensively inert in v1 (ally-granted Max HP does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct; the boss deals no damage). The three 'Coin' statuses are modeled as a monotonic resource pool `coinStage` (1=Sword from t=0, 2=Shield after 30 full charges, 3=Double Sword after her 5th burst while at Shield), read by resourceGate on the burst tiers — that is a STATE PROXY, not a kit-stated mechanic. ⚑ Coin exclusivity is the load-bearing unknown: this baseline assumes each 'continuously' status PERSISTS once granted (cumulative), so the 6.65% Attack Damage runs the whole fight; if the coins instead REPLACE each other, that buff dies at ~30 full charges and this override over-credits. ⚑ The burst's Shield-Coin tier is the ONLY Max-HP line that omits 'without restoring HP', so it is modeled as also emitting a recovery event (heal) — that is what wires it into an on-recovery consumer such as crown, and it is unmeasured. ⚑ The back-row activation condition has no representation in the engine (no row axis) and is assumed SATISFIED. See caveats.
caveats: ⚑ COIN EXCLUSIVITY (only damage-relevant unknown): modeled CUMULATIVE — each 'continuously' status persists once granted, so Sword Coin's Attack Damage ▲6.65% runs the whole fight and the burst Max-HP tiers stack once coinStage=3 (min-gates). If the coins instead REPLACE one another (Sword→Shield→Double Sword ladder), the 6.65% ends at ~30 full charges (~45-50s) and the burst tiers become mutually exclusive (change the burst resourceGates to exact min/max pairs). Kit text carries no removal/upgrade clause, hence the cumulative default.

⚑ BACK-ROW GATE DROPPED: 'Activates when assigned to the back row in battle' has no engine representation (no row/position axis, and no Block gate expresses it — `formation` only encodes noB1/hasB1). Assumed SATISFIED, so the Sword Coin block is a plain passive from t=0 and coinStage.initial=1. If the sim ever models placement, gate this block and set initial=0.

⚑ TARGET WIDTH: 'self and 2 allies on both sides' read as selfAndAdjacent sides:1 (self + 1 ally each side = 3 units). Alternative reading is 2 per side (sides:2, 5 units). Only affects who receives the 6.65% Attack Damage (and the inert Shield/Double-Sword HP lines).

⚑ FULL-CHARGE COUNTER ENCODING: 'attacking with Full Charge for N time(s)' modeled as `chargeCounter` with ONE effect per block — the two skill1 riders (Max HP, burst-CDR) are SPLIT into two single-effect blocks on purpose, because chargeCounter treats effects[P] as per-PHASE (a 2-effect block would fire them on alternating 8-charge cycles, not together). Verify the engine cycles a single-phase counter as 'every N charges'; if not, re-key to hitCount:{count:8} / {count:30} (an SR full-charges every shot, so hits ≈ full charges).

⚑ RECOVERY EVENT ON THE SHIELD-COIN BURST TIER: three of the four Max-HP lines say 'without restoring HP'; the Shield-Coin burst tier (20.1%) does NOT, so it is modeled with a `heal` effect (ticks:1) to fire allies' `recovery` triggers (crown-style on-recovery consumers). This is a deliberate tandem read of a kit-text distinction, NOT a measured mechanic — it is the only place this override can add damage through a teammate.

COIN STATE IS A PROXY: coinStage is not a kit-named currency; it exists solely so the burst tiers can be gated on Sword/Shield/Double-Sword status. On the 5th burst, slot ordering (skill2 blocks before burst blocks) may let the Double-Sword tier fire on the same cast that creates the status; in-game it more likely starts the FOLLOWING burst. Offensively inert either way.

Shield Coin's 'Damage Taken ▼15.2%' on ALLIES is unmodeled: the schema's damageTakenPct is a BOSS debuff (positive = boss takes more), so there is no ally damage-reduction stat to hold it, and the v1 boss deals no damage. The status itself is still tracked (coinStage=2) so the downstream gates stay faithful.

ALWAYS-⚑ items 5-7 are N/A here: the kit has no damage lines at all, so there is no noFb decision, no multi-projectile split/merge, no Hit-Rate→core magnitude, and no weapon-swap economy. noFb is not set anywhere; noRange is left to the engine.

Top-level `resources` on an override file is assumed supported (soda-twinkling-bunny precedent). If validate-overrides rejects it, drop the resourceGates and apply all three burst Max-HP tiers ungated — damage-neutral, since every Max-HP grant here is offensively inert.

flags.estimate: CUMULATIVE: 6.65% Attack Damage active for the whole fight (self + 1 ally each side)
flags.reasoning: Every coin line says 'continuously' and no line says the previous coin is consumed/replaced; the later blocks only cite the prior coin as a PREREQUISITE. But the escalating burst Max-HP tiers (10.15 → 20.1 → 30.02) read like a ladder where one tier applies at a time, which would mean Sword Coin is spent at 30 full charges (~45-50s) and the Attack Damage buff dies there. This is the only kit-parse choice on rouge that moves damage.
flags.recipe: Footage: watch rouge's buff-icon tray across the 30th full charge (≈45-50s) — does the Sword Coin icon persist alongside Shield Coin? Cross-check with an adjacent ally's popup values before/after that frame (a 6.65% Damage-Up drop is visible on a clean single-buff window). If replaced, set an exact resourceGate {min:1,max:1} on this block and on each burst tier.

flags.field: trigger cadence for chargeCounter counts 8 / 30 (skill1[*], skill2[1])
flags.estimate: 8 full charges ≈ 12-13s, 30 full charges ≈ 45-50s (from chargeFrames 60 = 1.0s charge, ammo 6, reloadFrames 161 ≈ 2.7s ⇒ ~9-10s per magazine of 6)
flags.reasoning: chargeFrames / reloadFrames / rate_of_fire are the known-unreliable datamine fields, and BOTH the 7s team burst-CDR frequency and the Shield-Coin timestamp hang off them. A 20% cadence error moves the CDR cadence — the largest damage lever in this kit — proportionally.
flags.recipe: Solo-record rouge and count full-charge shots against the on-screen ammo counter (ammo counter measures shots/sec directly, not a downstream proxy); timestamp the first burst-CDR proc (an ally's burst icon coming off cooldown 7s early) and the Shield Coin popup, then back out charges/sec.

flags.estimate: 7s CDR to all allies every 8 full charges (~every 12-13s), no per-battle cap
flags.reasoning: 'for 8 time(s)' is read as a recurring counter per the recurring-conditional-trigger rule, and oncePerBattle is left unset. If the game caps it (once per battle, or once per burst cycle), this over-credits the team's rotation speed substantially — CDR compounds into extra Full Bursts, so the error is not local.
flags.recipe: Count Full Bursts in a real rouge fight vs the sim's FB count (judge a rotation change by MEASURED FB count, not the aggregate ratio). An uncapped 7s/12s CDR should visibly compress the rotation; if the measured FB count matches a capped model instead, set oncePerBattle:true.

flags.field: burst[2].effects[1] (heal ticks:1 on the Shield-Coin Max-HP tier)
flags.estimate: ON — emits one recovery event to all allies per rouge burst while at Shield Coin or above
flags.reasoning: Three of four Max-HP lines carry 'without restoring HP' and this one does not, so the game clearly distinguishes them and this tier does fill the added HP. Whether a Max-HP-increase-with-fill fires 'when recovery takes effect' consumers (crown's on-recovery ATK buff, and crown is in the control comp) is NOT stated by the kit.
flags.recipe: Run the control comp with crown and watch for crown's on-recovery buffApply on rouge's burst frames once coinStage≥2; or in-game, check whether crown's on-recovery buff icon appears on a rouge burst with no other healer present. If it does not fire, delete this heal effect.

flags.estimate: sides:1 — self + 1 ally on each side (3 units)
flags.reasoning: 'self and 2 allies on both sides' most plausibly totals 2 allies (one per side); '2 on each side' would normally be written 'on each side' and total 4. Wrong width mis-scopes the only real damage buff in skill2 (6.65% Attack Damage) by up to two extra recipients.
flags.recipe: In-game, place rouge in slot 3 and read which allies show the Sword Coin buff icon; a 5-unit spread (sides:2) is unambiguous vs a 3-unit spread.

flags.estimate: Double Sword Coin lands on rouge's 5th own-burst cast, provided coinStage is already 2 (Shield); with a ~20s rotation that is ~t=90-105s, comfortably after the 30-charge Shield step
flags.reasoning: 'Activates when using Burst Skill for 5 time(s) … when in Shield Coin status' is ambiguous between 5 total burst uses (gated at fire time on Shield) and 5 burst uses WHILE in Shield status. This baseline picks the former (everyN:5 over all her casts + status gate). The Max-HP payload is offensively inert, so the choice only shifts when the burst's 30.02% tier begins.
flags.recipe: Count rouge bursts to the Double Sword Coin popup in footage; compare against the Shield Coin popup timestamp. If the count restarts at Shield, re-key to a resource counter incremented only while coinStage=2.

flags.field: resources[0] (coinStage state proxy) + burst resourceGate min-vs-exact
flags.estimate: coinStage monotonic 1→2→3, initial 1; burst tiers gated with min: so they STACK at higher stages
flags.reasoning: The engine has no ally-status channel (targetStatus is enemy-only), so the three coins are proxied by a resource pool. min-gating follows the cumulative assumption above; exclusive coins would need min/max pairs. Also, on the 5th burst the skill2 increment may be evaluated before the burst blocks, letting the 30.02% tier fire on the same cast that creates Double Sword (in-game it likely starts the next burst).
flags.recipe: Same footage check as the exclusivity flag; additionally confirm validate-overrides accepts a top-level `resources` array on this file (soda-twinkling-bunny precedent) — if not, drop the gates and apply all three tiers ungated (damage-neutral, all Max-HP grants are inert).
